data.source: Pinterest production API v5 public-pin metrics plus GA4 and first-party database acquisition checks
caveats: Captured about 17 seconds after production publication as a receipt baseline, not a performance verdict.

The bounded format experiment now has four Arm A clean Pins and six Arm B headline Pins. Arm B has one total public impression and Arm A has zero, with no format-cohort save, Pin click, outbound click, attributable site session, or downstream product click.

The full truthful public profile measured 262 impressions, two Pin clicks, one save, and zero outbound clicks immediately before publication; the single new impression since the previous run landed in the older editorial cohort, not the bounded format cohort.
Pinterest v3 and Sandbox are excluded. Revenue remains unavailable from the current affiliate reporting path and is null.
